minimum_delta: Extend existing continuity_resume.py as the sole context/routing owner. Reuse project identity, Project Map, RESUME, live bound-remote observation, native W/P verification, bootstrap challenge and finding lifecycle. No new durable directory, schema, project registry, store, service, daemon, plugin transport or Stage4 work.

Explicit bounded context: CORE_AUTHORITY and current TASK_CONTEXT by default. HISTORY_CONTEXT and PROGRAM_CONTEXT require exact task-needed references; framework-management-only sources are excluded from Consumers. Filter before source byte reads and before required-read presentation. History growth must not increase default file reads.

Machine context mode derives from project CONTROL identity/roots/profile and verified Git root: FRAMEWORK_MANAGEMENT, CONSUMER or UNBOUND. Conflicting declared mode, context, repository, partial governance or ambiguous root fails closed. An absent governance root in a real Git root is UNBOUND, never implicitly reconciliation.

RECOVERY_INDEX is a fixed read-only routing/index over existing native routes; it is not state or factual authority. Lifecycle routes cover NORMAL_BOUND, UNBOUND, STALE_STATE_OR_REMOTE, IDENTITY_MISMATCH, REVIEW_FINDING and RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Findings use exact local evidence references and require existing decision/FIX/re-review; a route never grants mutation.

route_project_context(root, selected_repository_id, expected_project_context_id=None, expected_state_revision=None, task_context_refs=(), program_context_refs=(), history_context_refs=()) returns a compact derived machine route, explicit context read plan, minimal named recovery references, authority facts and identical human handoff. Live Git identity/head and existing accepted W/P are verified for bound routes. Missing/unknown/contradictory evidence denies continuation.

load_continuity_resume retains native authority/status semantics and Stage2 snapshots, while automatically selecting bounded source checks and read plans. Existing execution-slot recovery and authority gates remain mandatory; no alternative execution authorization. Context/routing source markers are fingerprinted so changed context selection invalidates reuse.

Hierarchical roadmap/program handoff uses exact project-local task dependency references, validates their path/project identity when structured, and returns references rather than loading unrelated siblings or history. No new program authority or roadmap database.

Context efficiency/complexity fitness reports observable default file reads, history reads, human routing decisions, resume steps, unrelated reads, repeated semantic authority reads and recovery selection steps. Compare fresh instrumented v2.10.0/v2.11.0 sequences; historical or unavailable observations are NOT_OBSERVABLE.

Real Consumer acceptance branches from the completed Stage2 acceptance ref; business main remains untouched. Native scoped authority/PRE applies to acceptance evidence. Real fresh Unbound is a minimal isolated temporary GitHub repository or ungoverned acceptance checkout; no business bootstrap mutation is required. Controlled fixtures cover unsafe stale/mismatch/finding/reconciliation and growing/foreign context.

Focused RED/GREEN tests and affected native validators precede real acceptance, independent exact-W POST, explicit same-WorkUnit closure, STATE revision 46 and v2.11.0 tag/Release. One full release validation, clean projected artifact, remote source/assets/WP verification. Stop immediately after Stage3.
